text: A股三大指数早盘集体上涨，截至午盘，上证指数涨0.95%，深证成指涨1.19%，创业板指涨0.96%，北证50涨1.3%，科创50指数涨1.64%。全市场成交额9709亿元，较上日缩量187亿元，全市场超4800只个股上涨。板块题材上，军工装备、飞行汽车、贵金属、房地产、风电设备、电机、猪肉板块涨幅居前；元件、游戏、证券、电池、保险、AI视频板块表现相对落后。盘面上，2026年珠海航展规模创新高，军工装备、航空发动机板块大幅拉升，晟楠科技30cm涨停，晨曦航空、中科海讯20cm涨停，长城军工、甘化科工等20余股封板。房地产板块盘中走高，新城控股、深物业A
text_en: The three major A-share indexes rose collectively in early trading. As of midday, the Shanghai Composite Index rose 0.95%, the Shenzhen Component Index rose 1.19%, the ChiNext Index rose 0.96%, the BSE 50 rose 1.3%, and the STAR 50 Index rose 1.64%. Total market turnover was 970.9 billion yuan, down 18.7 billion yuan from the previous day, with more than 4,800 stocks in the whole market rising. By sector themes, military equipment, flying cars, precious metals, real estate, wind power equipment, motors, and pork sectors were among the top gainers; components, gaming, securities, batteries, insurance, and AI video sectors lagged relatively. On the board, the 2026 Zhuhai Airshow reached a record scale, and military equipment and aero-engine sectors surged, with Shengnan Technology hitting the 30cm limit up, Chenxi Aviation and Zhongke Haixun hitting the 20cm limit up, and more than 20 stocks including Great Wall Military Industry and Ganhua Science & Industry sealing the limit up.
